lore.short_description: Unrelenting fury and primal violence define this path of rage.
lore.full_text: For some barbarians. rage is a means to an end-that end being violence. The Path of the Berserker is a path of untrammeled fury, slick with blood. As you enter the berserker's rage. you thrill in the chaos of battle, heedless of your own health or well-being.
